name: La Pobla de Cérvoles (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over yellow, the light blue charged towards the hoist with two white hinds one above the other.
history: The official flag of La Pobla de Cérvoles is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, a horizontal bicolour of light blue and yellow, with the two white hinds of the arms, each 9/40 of the height and 2/15 of the length of the cloth; approved on 21 June 2006 and published in the DOGC on 4 July 2006.

features.role: two hinds (cérvoles) one above the other
